The instrument features a symmetrical facade with multiple towers of vertical metal pipes of varying heights, creating a stepped silhouette. The casing is elaborately carved wood with gold accents and decorative moldings. The lower section shows a gallery railing, but the console (keyboards and pedalboard) is not visible in this upward-angled shot.
